summary: Iteration 6 tested all 7 requested items. All passed. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (tests/test_iter6_card_music.py). /assets/oval-sky.webp?v=2 is a 1100x1600 WebP of 150,906 bytes, and ShareCard.jsx references ?v=2. welcome-theme.ogg (OggS) and .mp3 are served as real audio, not the HTML fallback. CREDITS.md has 'Original score, made for Weave Him'. CARD_VERSION=3 and PREVIEW_SITE_LABEL='weavehim.[domain]'. card.jpg for the existing husbands 284b7xvg and ws5g2waz is a 1080x1920 JPEG of about 600KB. Visual check of the card: the oval shows the wicker figure under the dark lower gradient; the name (EDMUND / ELLIS) is readable; the site line reads '(Weave yours at weavehim.[domain])' on one line; the credit 'Inspired by Wicker, in cinemas now · An unofficial fan creation · Built on Emergent' is one line at the bottom with Wicker in italics. og.jpg is 720x1280. Unknown id returns 404. The share page og:image is correct. Frontend at 390x844 (Save tested at 1920). Music: the wordmark painted at 0.22s, and the single /audio/welcome-theme.ogg request came at about 0.98s. It was fetched only once over leave/return/mute cycles. An AudioContext spy showed a loop source starting after the first click, with ctx running and decodeAudioData called once. Commission moves to /strand/1 in 0.05s and the source is stopped (wanted=false). Returning to Welcome restarts it. Mute stops it and unmute resumes it on Welcome. With localStorage weave-him-muted='1', clicks and keys never start the music. With document.hidden + visibilitychange, it stops when hidden and restarts when visible on Welcome, and does not restart on /strand/1. No console or page errors. Credit: the Welcome footer and the public /h/:id page show the credit with Wicker in an <i>. The How it works sheet has [data-testid=fan-disclaimer] with the exact text. Share reveal: clicks on the backdrop and the action area at t≈0.25s do NOT close it; reveal-save-button is disabled early and enabled after about 1.6s. After the reveal, a backdrop click, X and Escape each close it. Copy link shows the 'Link copied' toast. On desktop, Save downloads ellis-woven-by-hand.jpg (1080x1920 JPEG, 618KB, credit on one line). Tell: the long strand 'Extraordinarilylongword...' now wraps (span right edge 342 vs card 366, doc width 390, no overflow). Regression: a full UI flow (7 strands) reached /meet/2hdvvbe5 with band text lines, and the reveal works.

issues: Carried over from iteration 5: with a long custom strand, the strand lines under the name are very small (about 12px on a 1080 card), so they are close to illegible in the thumbnail.

critical_code_review_comments: sound.js loadMusic: on a fetch failure, music.loading stays as a resolved promise and raw stays null, so the music never retries in that session. Optional: reset music.loading = null in the catch.
In dev, React StrictMode runs the Welcome effect as enter/leave/enter on return. That gives start, stop (1.2s fade) and start, so two sources overlap briefly. Production is not affected.
Escape closes the ShareReveal even during the reveal; only the backdrop click is gated by `revealed`. This is acceptable, but note the inconsistency.

render_for uses h.credit whenever it isn't the '[Inspired-by' placeholder. A husband saved with an older custom credit string would keep that text. The current DB only has the placeholder, empty or the new line, so this is fine now.
The music is fetched even when muted (it never plays). This is fine, but it costs about 290KB on muted visits.
seed_data_creation: Created husband 2hdvvbe5 (Silas) via the UI full flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iter6_card_music.py -n 0. Music spy: subclass window.AudioContext in add_init_script and count createBufferSource().start/stop where buffer.duration > 10 (only the music is that long). Fake a hidden tab by overriding document.hidden with defineProperty and dispatching visibilitychange. The owner meet page needs localStorage 'weave-him-tokens' = {ws5g2waz: 'hxpAdtQE1wBYNQW5NUdbX-Ha'}. The public /h/:id page has no share-him-button.
